description: Every host this daemon knows. Each vibed calls itself `local`, with the link `local`; other hosts come with #16, and their links are `connected` or `down`. `external` says which host is the external address (#18), and `mcp` whether a host serves MCP now (this session's vibed doesn't). Examples from here on are one session, in file order, on a Mac whose home is /Users/me.
